values.note: Peak season (2026-03-21 to 11-15): standard site $37, electric $46, double $74. Off-peak (Nov 16 to mid-March): standard $35, electric $44, double $70. Extra vehicles $5 each.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231993/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 37 / STANDARD ELECTRIC 46; Non-Peak 35 / 44) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/davidson-river-recreation-area ('Single Site: $37 per night', 'Single Site with electric hook-up: $46 per night', 'Double Site: $74 per night'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 231993 (30 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, Electricity Hookup '50' on 27 and '50/30' on 3; no water or sewer hookup attributes), fetched 2026-10-20

values.note: 132 reservable sites (102 standard, 30 electric) in eight loops, plus 12 management sites. Most take 28-40 ft; one lists 67 ft and one 58 ft. 30 pull-throughs. Generators are not allowed on Poplar Loop (sites 99-113).

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 231993 (fetched 2026-10-20: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231993 ('Campsites are organized into eight loops'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hot showers and flush toilets in each loop; ice and firewood sold on site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/davidson-river-recreation-area ('The facility also provides hot showers and restrooms with flush toilets in each loop. Campers can purchase ice and firewood on-site'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/davidson-river-recreation-area ('The facility is open year-round', 'Seasons of Use Year-round'), read 2026-10-22

status.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/231993/month (November 2026 sites Available/Reserved; no closure notice on the campground or the Forest Service page; the modernization closure noted in inclusion_evidence has ended), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Operated by the concessionaire Naventure. Reservations 'required from March 23 to November 15'; a few first-come sites are offered in winter only, with same-day walk-up only from November 16 to March 22. Six-month rolling window; 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Sites must be occupied the first night or the reservation is cancelled. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231993 (rules reservationWindow 6 Months, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices 'A number of first-come, first-serve sites are offered during the winter only', 'This campground is managed by Naventure') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/davidson-river-recreation-area ('Reservations available year round and required from March 23 to November 15', 'Same day walk up only permitted from November 16, 2023 to March 22'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Open again after the modernization closure (Nov 2026 availability on recreation.gov); confirmed $35-46 rates, 50-amp electric; added 132 sites with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets, year-round season, recreation.gov booking with a 6-month window, 14-night max and winter-only first-come sites. Operated by concessionaire Naventure (phone 828-885-7557 matches). No min stay. Note unchanged.
